# REDCapExploreR

REDCapExploreR provides exploratory tools for REDCap projects accessed
through the REDCap API. Use it to build structured codebooks, review
form completion with record status dashboards, and generate general data
quality reports.

## Installation

You can install the development version of REDCapExploreR like so:

``` r

devtools::install_github("CHOP-CGTInformatics/REDCapExploreR")
```

## Core workflows

Store REDCap credentials outside your scripts, then pass them to the
build functions:

``` r

library(REDCapExploreR)

redcap_uri <- Sys.getenv("REDCAP_URI")
token <- Sys.getenv("REDCAP_TOKEN")

status_data <- build_record_status_data(
  redcap_uri = redcap_uri,
  token = token
)
plot_record_status(status_data)

codebook <- build_codebook(redcap_uri = redcap_uri, token = token)
quality_report <- build_quality_report(redcap_uri = redcap_uri, token = token)
```

Quality reports include selected checks, thresholds, evaluation date,
and package version in `quality_report$metadata$settings`. Their printed
overview also states how many field-row values were eligible for
missingness assessment.

The package includes `mock_redcap_project`, `mock_record_status_data`,
`mock_codebook`, and `mock_quality_report` for offline exploration. See
[Get
Started](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/articles/REDCapExploreR.html)
for an overview, the [function
reference](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/index.html)
for complete API documentation, and the [quality report
article](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/articles/quality-report.html)
for a comprehensive guide to quality report checks, output elements, and
assumptions.

## Field relationships

A codebook supplies field definitions, expressions, and event/repeat
context. Build it once to explore several fields without additional API
calls or record exports:

``` r

library(REDCapExploreR)
relationships <- field_relationship_summary("weight_kg", mock_codebook)
relationships
#> <REDCap field relationships>
#> Field: weight_kg (follow_up)
#> Upstream: 1 item
#> Downstream: 6 direct items, 1 indirect item
#> Reference occurrences across returned chains: 12
#> Action-tag condition: 1; Calculation: 1; Piping: 4; Field embedding: 1; Default value: 3; Unknown relationship type: 1; Branching logic: 1
#> Interpretation issues: 3 related metadata locations (see issues).
#> Project Coverage: project-wide metadata inspection; see coverage for sources and exclusions.
#> Indirect connections are reference chains, not predictions of value or behavior changes.
#> Project interpretation limits are summarized in coverage.
```

Use `relationships$references` for original expressions and
`relationships$issues` for related interpretation issues and
`relationships$coverage` for project-wide inspection scope, identical
for every field summarized from the same codebook. The viewer uses the
same Upstream, Downstream, Summary, and Project Coverage terms and shows
all references by default. The bundled codebook includes indirect paths,
annotations, and interpretation notes around `weight_kg`. Request
`include_diagnostics = TRUE` when constructing the report to include
Project Diagnostics: interpretation issues across the entire project.
Request `include_inspection_log = TRUE` separately for the exhaustive
inspection log, including blank and unavailable locations. View and save
with
[`view_field_relationship_summary()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/view_field_relationship_summary.md)
and
[`save_field_relationship_summary()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/save_field_relationship_summary.md).

## Collaboration

We invite you to give feedback and collaborate with us! If you are
familiar with GitHub and R packages, please feel free to submit a [pull
request](https://github.com/CHOP-CGTInformatics/REDCapExploreR/pulls).
Please do let us know if REDCapExploreR fails for whatever reason with
your database and submit a bug report by creating a GitHub
[issue](https://github.com/CHOP-CGTInformatics/REDCapExploreR/issues).

Please note that this project is released with a [Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://github.com/CHOP-CGTInformatics/REDCapExploreR/blob/main/CONDUCT.md).
By participating you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Pull REDCap Data

Retrieve REDCap project data and metadata from the API.

- [`pull_redcap_project()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/pull_redcap_project.md)
  : Pull REDCap project data for quality reporting

## Build Codebooks

Build and view REDCap project codebooks.

- [`build_codebook()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/build_codebook.md)
  : Build a REDCap codebook
- [`save_codebook()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/save_codebook.md)
  : Save a REDCap codebook viewer
- [`view_codebook()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/view_codebook.md)
  : View a REDCap codebook as interactive HTML tables

## Explore Field Relationships

Explain field references, connections, and source coverage.

- [`field_relationship_summary()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/field_relationship_summary.md)
  : Summarize how a REDCap field is related to project metadata
- [`view_field_relationship_summary()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/view_field_relationship_summary.md)
  : View a field relationship summary
- [`save_field_relationship_summary()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/save_field_relationship_summary.md)
  : Save a field relationship viewer

## Build Quality Reports

Build exploratory REDCap data quality reports.

- [`build_quality_report()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/build_quality_report.md)
  : Build a REDCap data quality report

## Record Status Dashboard

Recreate and plot REDCap Record Status Dashboard data.

- [`build_record_status_data()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/build_record_status_data.md)
  : Build Record Status Dashboard data
- [`plot_record_status()`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/plot_record_status.md)
  : Plot Record Status Dashboard data

## Data

Synthetic REDCap-shaped datasets for examples and documentation.

- [`mock_redcap_project`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/mock_redcap_project.md)
  : Mock REDCap project
- [`mock_record_status_data`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/mock_record_status_data.md)
  : Mock Record Status Dashboard data
- [`mock_codebook`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/mock_codebook.md)
  : Mock REDCap codebook
- [`mock_quality_report`](https://chop-cgtinformatics.github.io/REDCapExploreR/reference/mock_quality_report.md)
  : Mock REDCap quality report
